scope: Resolved normal/build source candidates after exact sharp POSIX recipe edits; includes build dependencies and does not prove final linked-code retention.

verification.method: cargo tree --frozen --target TARGET -p librsvg-c --edges normal,build --prefix depth --format {p}|features={f}
verification.toolchainLimit: The installed toolchain resolved the frozen manifests only; it was not used to compile code requiring Rust 1.92.0.
verification.cargoTreeLimit: Cargo documents this as a close view of the build graph, not a guarantee of exact build or final linkage equivalence.
